description: The story of Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman evicted from the apartment she lived in for over 70 years, is the story of the Bronx. Jose Vega on housing, the Epstein class, and the choice between dignity and subjugation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Vega for Congress
title: Dignity, Or Subjugation | Jose Vega for Congress 2026 | Let's Save the Bronx
